subject: CAIQ: assertion consolidation & evidence queue plan
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@hortonhealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@hortonhealth.com
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ intake: control mapping + evidence for onboarding

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. As part of our procurement & security intake, we need a consolidated CAIQ crosswalk that ties Redwood's questionnaire responses to specific runtime artifacts. Our audit window is the week of June 14, so would like to collect the following by June 8 if possible:  

- CAIQ assertions mapped to control IDs for the Runtime & Telemetry, Cryptography, and Tenant Segregation domains.
- Representative runtime telemetry snippets showing request traces and KV cache isolation (sanitized).
- Keystore/HSM rotation process and proof of recent rotation.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the artifacts and whether we should upload to the shared Drive folder or you will push an evidence bundle? If there are any controls that are answered as compensating controls, please flag them in the mapping.

Attachments: none (we can share template if helpful).

Thanks,
Lina Park
Head of Vendor Risk
Horton Health
security@hortonhealth.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@hortonhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-02T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: control mapping + evidence for onboarding

Hi Lina —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can deliver a consolidated CAIQ crosswalk and an evidence batch by your June 8 target. Proposed plan:

1) Crosswalk spreadsheet (CAIQ -> internal control IDs -> artifact pointers) — mine to own, deliver v1 by EOD June 4. Link below.
2) Telemetry snippets — Marissa will curate sanitized traces and a short README explaining sampling approach; ETA June 6.
3) Keystore/HSM rotation proof — Kimberly will attach the rotation SOP and the last rotation timestamp and signer extract; ETA June 6.

I'll flag any responses that rely on compensating controls in the 'Notes' column of the crosswalk. We will upload everything to the shared Drive folder you suggested (see link) and will also provide a zip export if legal/procurement prefers a bundle.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCAIQ-crosswalk

Small asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the CAIQ version you want us to align to (v3.1 or your custom template)?
- Do you want raw log snippets or pre-redacted excerpts? We can do either; raw with redaction guidance is preferable for traceability.

Assigning owners here so the handoff is explicit: Kimberly (keystore proofs), Marissa (telemetry + runtime samples), Jonas (crosswalk + upload).

Thanks — I'll ping again once v1 is up.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@hortonhealth.com>, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-03T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: control mapping + evidence for onboarding

On Tue, Jun 2, 2027 at 11:25 AM, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Appreciate the clear ask. We can deliver a consolidated CAIQ crosswalk and an evidence batch by your June 8 target.

Hi Lina,

Dropping the artifacts I own into the Drive folder today. Quick summary of what I'm uploading:

- keystore-rotation-process.pdf (SOP, includes the HSM rotation checklist and signer list)
- kms-rotation-timestamps.csv (redacted identifier + last rotation UTC timestamp)
- keystore-attestation.txt (hash & signature extract for rotation event)

Notes on scope: the rotation artifacts show our rotation cadence (30-day rotation for ephemeral keys, annual for root material) and chain-of-custody entries. If you need HSM-backed key identifiers we can provide a notarized extract under an NDA; the SOP provides the control mapping details.

Marissa — I left a short README in the folder with the naming convention so telemetry snippets map back to the crosswalk rows.

Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: keystore-rotation-process.pdf, kms-rotation-timestamps.csv

From: Lina Park <lina.park@hortonhealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-05T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: control mapping + evidence for onboarding

Thanks all — I confirmed receipt of the crosswalk v1 and the keystore artifacts in the Drive. A few quick items:  

- CAIQ version: please map to CSA CAIQ 3.1 (our questionnaire is aligned to 3.1).
- Telemetry: sanitized excerpts are fine as long as each snippet includes the trace id and a short description of sampling filters.
- Compensating controls: if any control is covered by a compensating control, please mark it as "compensating" in the Notes column and include the rationale.

Timeline check: we reviewed the partial package and can accept the bulk upload by June 8. After that we'll circulate to internal engineering for a deeper review and may request a short Zoom for any clarifications.

If you can also add a short cover note (one paragraph) describing how Redwood routes runtime requests across tenancy boundaries (we'll include that as context for our reviewers).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the final bundle.

Best,
Lina
Head of Vendor Risk
Horton Health
